en: Colorized vintage postcard showing the garden of the Achilleion palace in Corfu. It depicts a formal landscaped garden with hedges, palm trees and statues, including a prominent seated figure in the center. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk among the paths and stairs. At the right is a neoclassical building with columns. Printed captions in French and another language identify the scene as the garden of the Achilleion in Corfu.
